g.text: Current clock shift, real bias and divide-by-two loop
Current netlist view; all NMOS bodies -> VSS, all PMOS bodies -> VDD. Local bias is shared by the three /2 cells of a prescaler.
A. Source follower (one leg; the other leg is identical)
ckp -> master Xct + slave Xch gates
Increasing Wsf at roughly fixed sink current lowers VGS;
the internal clock common mode rises. Both latch gates load ckp.
PMOS gates share pdiode. NMOS diode sets vbias_logic.
External global vbias still comes from the shared reference.
Inverted output feedback makes a toggle /2. A shift-register DFF instead receives external data.
